description: This file contains the 'NoteEditorViewModel' class, which manages the creation, editing, loading, saving, and deletion of notes within the application. It interacts with the NoteRepository to perform data operations and is part of the UI layer, specifically for note editing functionality.

classes.name: NoteEditorViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel for managing note creation, editing, loading, saving, and deletion operations in the app. It uses MutableLiveData to observe note data and coroutines for asynchronous repository interactions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a note by its ID and updates the LiveData accordingly. If the ID is null or zero, clears the current note.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a note with the given title and content. Determines whether to add a new note or update an existing one based on the note ID. Calls a callback upon completion.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID and invokes a callback when done.
